messages:
maria.g: Quick heads-up — seeing a small latency regression on paged-attn + flash-fuse in micro-batch heavy workloads (seq 8k). P99 up ~3-5% on Canary. Can someone run a microbatch/backpressure bench and capture kernel/prof traces? cc @jonathan.w @sree.k

jonathan.w: Which commit + model? baseline comparison? Also attach the perf-run id if available.

maria.g: Canary is at commit 3f4b2d (PR #4120). Model: llama-13b-8k, batch=4, micro_batch=2. Baseline is previous canary 3f4a9c. No perf-run id yet.

sree.k: My hunch is KV eviction thrash with paged attention + fuse. If eviction happens during generation it can spike memcpy/paging. Try toggling `KV_EVICTION_STRATEGY` and set `PAGED_WINDOW` bigger first. Also enable stats: `export PAGED_ATTENTION_STATS=1` and `FLASH_ATTENTION_DEBUG=1`.

alex.t: I'll run; kicking off now. Command I'm using:
```bash
scripts/bench/run_attention.py \
  --model llama-13b-8k \
  --commit 3f4b2d \
  --seq 8192 \
  --batch 4 \
  --micro-batch 2 \
  --profile nvprof \
  --trace-id 1940102030-1
```

perf-bot: perf-bench started: run_id=bench-1940102030-1; node=gpu-pool-2; started=2026-03-15T12:00:01Z

jonathan.w: Run two variations — `--fuse flash` and `--no-fuse` for baseline. Also grab `heaptrack`/`cuda-memcheck` if possible. Please tag the artifacts in the run.

alex.t: Ran both. Quick numbers from bench-1940102030-1:
- baseline (`--no-fuse`) median token latency: 38.2ms, p99: 45.1ms
- fused (`--fuse flash`) median token latency: 39.5ms, p99: 47.0ms (+4.3% p99)

Also saw periodic spikes aligning with KV eviction logs. Attached nvprof hotspots (uploaded to run). Heap allocs show churn around KV cache resize.

sree.k: That matches. Next try: increase `PAGED_WINDOW=12288` and set `KV_GC_THRESHOLD=0.8` then rerun fused case. Also try `KV_EVICTION_STRATEGY=retain_prefix`.

maria.g: Thanks. Can you also try a micro-batch backpressure config: `BATCH_QUEUE_LIMIT=8` and `MICROBATCH_BACKPRESSURE=1` to simulate high-concurrency clients.

alex.t: Scheduling those now; putting a 1h run queue. Will post run ids when done.

jonathan.w: If numbers still regress, let's open a short PR to gate the flash fusion flag behind a nightly experiment and roll back if p99 worsens on canary. Keep notes for changelog.

maria.g: Agreed. Thanks everyone — ping me if you need extra quota on dedicated nodes. :thumbsup:
